body: Social Security Act 2018 section 78 provides that MSD may grant a child disability allowance for a child if the child is a child with a serious disability and is being cared for either in the home of the child's principal caregiver or temporary OB or UCB caregiver, or in approved weekly accommodation where the child is cared for by the child's parent or guardian during school holidays or weekends. Approved weekly accommodation means accommodation operated by an approved voluntary organisation and for which the child's parent or guardian is required to contribute to the cost.

Social Security Act 2018 section 79 defines a child with a serious disability as a dependent child who has a disability and, because of that disability, needs constant care and attention and is likely to need that care and attention permanently or for a period exceeding 12 months. In determining whether the child needs constant care and attention, MSD must consider whether the child requires frequent attention in connection with bodily functions, substantially more attention and supervision than is normally required by a child of the same age and sex, or regular supervision to avoid substantial danger to the child or others.

Social Security Act 2018 section 80 provides that MSD may require an application for a child disability allowance to be supported by a medical certificate certifying whether, in the opinion of a prescribed health practitioner, the child is a child with a serious disability within the meaning of section 79.

Social Security Act 2018 section 81 provides that, before granting a child disability allowance, MSD may require the child to be examined by a prescribed health practitioner nominated for the purpose by MSD.

Social Security Act 2018 section 82 provides that MSD may pay a child disability allowance granted under section 78(1) to the principal caregiver or temporary OB or UCB caregiver for the child or, if there is no such person, to the person for the time being having the care and control of the child.

Social Security Act 2018 section 83 provides that a child disability allowance is not payable in addition to any benefit granted to the child under the Act, except an orphan's benefit, an unsupported child's benefit, or a disability allowance; any pension or allowance granted to the child under the Veterans' Support Act 2014, except a children's pension; or weekly compensation payable to the child under the Accident Compensation Act 2001.

Social Security Act 2018 Schedule 4 Part 9, as amended on 1 April 2026 by the Social Security (Rates of Benefits and Allowances) Order 2026, sets the rate of child disability allowance at $62.43 a week.
